latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — helps users turn a completed research argument into a clear, reader-focused research paper plan.

- Guides users in organizing their existing claim, reasons, evidence, and objections into a coherent paper structure.
- Identifies and corrects common structural pitfalls: research journey narrative, source patchwork, and assignment-prompt order.
- Produces a sequenced storyboard with section-by-section planning (introduction, body, and conclusion).
- Offers prompts and frameworks for sketching a working introduction and deciding section order.
- Prerequisite: Users must have an assembled argument; argument-building is not included in this skill.
